run_random_search: run a random search on a CompilerEnv to optimize LLVM compilation flags within a time budget
apply_optimized_state: apply the best optimization state found by random search back to the original environment
create_optimization_target_env: create a new environment from an OptimizationTarget using the make_env lambda for random search
configure_search_patience: configure the patience parameter to control how many steps without improvement before resetting the search trajectory
use_transient_cache: use transient_cache_path to create a temporary directory for storing random search results during autotuning
